designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1987 under the Endangered Species Act and the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, mainly to protect wintering habitat for the Aleutian cackling (Canada) goose.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act; Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: San Joaquin River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Aug. 16, 2007 (E7-16107): "The Refuge was established in 1987 primarily to protect and manage wintering habitat for Aleutian Canada geese"
